import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { address } from "../../../backend/schema/address";

export const addressCms = customizeTable<typeof address>("address", {
    display: {
        title: "address"
    },
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    listFields: ["addressId", "phone", "lastUpdate", "city", "address", "address2"],
    fields: {
        address: {
            multiline: true
        },
        address2: {
            multiline: true
        },
        district: {
            multiline: true
        },
        postalCode: {
            multiline: true
        },
        phone: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "addressId",
        "phone",
        "lastUpdate",
        "city",
        "address",
        "address2",
        "district",
        "postalCode"
    ]
});
